output.headline: Northgate probe patiently while trailing 1-0
output.text: Trailing 1-0, Northgate Rovers recycle through Ilan Cohen, Kai Nakamura and Andres Vega, all unpressured, after Oscar Blum's saved 0.09 xG shot. Chaos sits at 54 and momentum at -26, so the patient possession hasn't yet turned pressure into danger.
